content.short: SMPLR provides a complete overview of your firm's crypto and fiat finances in real-time.
content.description: SMPLR makes it easy to start using crypto without requiring knowledge of blockchain concepts. It provides comprehensive reporting that reconciles and organizes every transaction for audit, tax, and reporting needs. The platform handles transaction aggregation, manual reconciliation, and accounting workflows, helping you stay compliant and focused on financial planning and performance. With SMPLR, you can gain clear visibility into your crypto activity and streamline financial operations.
